name: Naturepedia™ Change Log
description: Machine-readable incremental update feed for Naturepedia™, Robbie's Razor™, Plate™ systems, official MCP infrastructure, AI discovery infrastructure, x402 retrieval, and canonical registries.

entries.summary: Upgraded the public Recursive Registry Inheritance Principle (RRIP™) endpoint from a descriptive-only architecture document to RRIP 2.1.0, an operational canonical-object resolver capable of resolving registered Naturepedia™ Plate™ identities, parent-family context, inheritance boundaries, declared higher-order resources, structured-payload availability, and payment eligibility without exposing protected payloads or triggering speculative payment requests.

Preserved backward-compatible descriptor mode when no id parameter is supplied
Added canonical-object-resolution mode using the id query parameter

Added canonical Plate identity, parent-family identity, canonical URL, parent preview, declared Registry, declared System Map, and declared Knowledge Mesh discovery metadata
Added structured-payload availability and individual Plate route-status signaling
Preserved RRIP as a free public control-plane endpoint
Prevented RRIP from returning protected structured payload contents
Prevented RRIP resolution from performing x402 settlement
Defined unknown canonical objects as HTTP 404 PLATE_NOT_FOUND with no payment challenge
Defined ambiguous identifiers as HTTP 409 AMBIGUOUS_PLATE_IDENTIFIER with no payment challenge
Defined empty identifiers as HTTP 400 INVALID_PLATE_IDENTIFIER
Changed the descriptor retrieval sequence from unconditional Settlement to Conditional Settlement
Added an explicit pathway boundary stating that Plate registration does not imply an instantiated Meta-Registry, Graph Registry™, Knowledge Mesh, structured payload, or paid resource
Validated canonical resolution using fibonacci#pisano-periods-constraint-bifurcation-plate
Confirmed Pisano resolution returns parent family Fibonacci Plates with structured payload status not-registered and individual Plate route status reserved
Confirmed Pisano RRIP resolution reports payment eligibility as not-eligible-without-registered-structured-payload

Updated the Naturepedia v2 Discovery Index to document RRIP 2.1.0 operating modes, resolution semantics, fail-closed behavior, and access boundaries
entries.governanceBoundary: RRIP resolution establishes canonical identity and declared inheritance context only. Resolver success does not establish empirical validation, instantiate undeclared higher-order resources, activate a protected payload, perform settlement, grant commercial reuse rights, or imply that a published pricing class is an active payable product.
